items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Because he was with Joe Abraham Tillman, I think.

ctx.x: I know Bill Russell told me that you wanted to record with Percy. What's that? Bill Russell had told me that you wanted to record with Percy. Way back.

That must have been about 44, 45. Yeah, about... Maybe 49. Maybe 49. I don't know. No, I don't think... No, 49, no. Must have been... Because he was with Joe Abraham Tillman, I think. I thought it was maybe the ones that were done with...
Herb Moran or somebody. That was 49. Well, I don't know.
